chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: This is one of the wonderful interpretations related from him.

key_terms.التَّفْسِيرِ: interpretation or exegesis of the Quran
key_terms.السَّيِّدُ الرِّضَى: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī, a prominent Shia scholar and compiler of Nahj al-Balagha
key_terms.غَرِيبِ: rare, unique, or strange (in the scholarly sense of a less common report)

ai.seo_question: What does As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī mean by describing a tafsir as 'gharib'?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Radi, the compiler of Nahj al-Balagha, highlights the rarity (gharib) of this specific interpretive report, underscoring the meticulous transmission chain (isnad) valued in Shia scholarship. This remark emphasizes the preservation of unique exegetical insights that may not appear in more common canonical tafsir sources, reflecting the depth of the Imam's knowledge.
